name: Feldon
description: Scholar from the Ronom Glacier who fled Terisia City with the Golgothian Sylex.

description_citations.text: "Third Path". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feldon finds the first of his canes frozen in the Ronom Glacier.
timeline.quote: Feldon found the first of these canes frozen in the Ronom Glacier.

citation.text: Feldon's Cane (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: On an expedition Feldon finds a mystical cane with unknown runic symbols.
timeline.quote: In one expedition, he found a mystical cane marked with unknown runic symbols.

citation.text: "Feldon", section "Early years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feldon co-founds the Union of the Third Path and meets Loran.
timeline.quote: Feldon was one of the Third Path 's founders, and it was here that he met the Argivian woman Loran , another founder.

citation.text: "Feldon", section "The Third Path". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feldon receives the Golgothian Sylex and Coral Helm from the Yumok and learns magic from Hurkyl.
timeline.quote: He also started learning magic from Hurkyl , eventually learning to tap into the red mana of his mountain home.

citation.text: "Feldon", section "The Third Path". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feldon sends Loran away with the Golgothian Sylex since his lame leg would slow her; she is captured by Ashnod and tortured.
timeline.quote: Loran did as she was bid, but she was captured by Ashnod who tortured her

citation.text: "Feldon", section "Betrayal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After ten years Loran escapes (or is let go) and finds Feldon; they marry and live near Ronom Glacier.
timeline.quote: Loran tracked down Feldon in his home by the glacier, and they were married.

citation.text: "Feldon", section "After the Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sylex Blast is triggered and Feldon and Loran realize the war is over.
timeline.quote: Feldon and Loran realized the war was finally over.

citation.text: "Feldon", section "After the Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Loran dies ten years after the Sylex Blast; Feldon grieves and tries to replace her with an automaton before giving up.
timeline.quote: led to Loran's death ten years after the Sylex Blast .

citation.text: "Feldon", section "After the Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feldon seeks out other mages to bring Loran back, meeting the Hedge Wizard with green magic who cannot help.
timeline.quote: But his green magic only influenced the living, not the dead.

citation.text: "Feldon", section "The study of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A black mage teaches Feldon a spell in exchange for his cane, but it creates a zombified Loran; Feldon unsummons it and the mage vanishes with the cane.
timeline.quote: Disgusted, Feldon unsummoned the creature before he could lay eyes on it, but by then the black mage had disappeared completely.

citation.text: "Feldon", section "The study of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A white scholar teaches Feldon that magic can only summon copies; Feldon creates a copy of Loran, says goodbye and lets her go.
timeline.quote: after saying goodbye to her he let the summoned being go.

citation.text: "Feldon", section "The study of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feldon gets over his grief, shares his library, and becomes important in early magical research on Terisiare.
timeline.quote: Saying goodbye helped Feldon get over his grief and he lived out his days in happiness.

citation.text: "Feldon", section "The study of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yumok fishermen accidentally net the Sylex in 36 AR and send it to Feldon in Terisia City.
timeline.quote: The Sylex was accidentally netted by Yumok fishermen in 36 AR , and sent to Feldon in Terisia City for study.

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Discovery and use". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Loran travels from Penregon to Terisia City and meets the scholars at the Ivory Tower.
timeline.quote: She arrived at the Ivory Tower and there met Feldon

citation.text: "Loran", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Yumok deliver the Sylex to Feldon; Feldon and Loran feel darkness on touching it.
timeline.quote: they felt a darkness come over them as if the sun had fallen behind an eclipse

citation.text: "Loran", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Fall of Terisia City, Loran escapes with the Sylex but is caught in an avalanche triggered by Ashnod, who captures her.
timeline.quote: The avalanche had been triggered by Ashnod, who discovered the Sylex and took both it and Loran into captivity.

citation.text: "Loran", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feldon rescues Loran after several years.
timeline.quote: After several years, Feldon found and rescued Loran

citation.text: "Loran", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Loran and Feldon are at the Ronom Glacier for the Sylex Blast and she says 'Good.'
timeline.quote: Realizing the war was over, Loran simply said "Good."

citation.text: "Loran", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Loran dies in bed ten years after the blast.
timeline.quote: Loran died ten years after the Sylex Blast

citation.text: "Loran", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feldon temporarily resurrects Loran with white mana.
timeline.quote: He did so with white mana, but only long enough for him to say goodbye.

citation.text: "Loran", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feldon revives Loran with magic but she is not the real Loran, and he lets her go.
timeline.quote: Feldon says goodbye to her and lets her go.

citation.text: "The Colors of Magic", section "Loran's Smile , by Jeff Grubb". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Terisia City falls after a siege; Feldon and Loran flee with the Golgothian Sylex.
timeline.quote: The Third Path suffered heavy losses during the Fall of Terisia City

citation.text: "Third Path", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Third Path scatters across the lands after the fall.
timeline.quote: After Terisia's fall, the members of the Third Path scattered across the lands.

citation.text: "Third Path", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As Terisia City burns, Feldon presses the sylex into Loran's hands and urges her to run.
timeline.quote: As Terisia City burned, Feldon pressed the sylex into Loran's hands and urged her to run.

citation.text: Loran's Escape (The Brothers' War, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Feldon, aided by Loran, secretly smuggles the Golgothian Sylex out another way.
timeline.quote: Feldon was aided by Loran in secretly smuggling the Golgothian Sylex out

citation.text: "Drafna", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feldon gives the Sylex to Loran to flee with.
timeline.quote: so he gave it to Loran and asked her to flee with him on her quick legs

citation.text: "Fall of Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Invited to Terisia City, Hurkyl joins others to establish the Union of the Third Path, seeking neutrality in the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: Hurkyl joined her husband, Feldon , Chayum-Icha , Kathwar , and others to attend meetings to establish the Union of the Third Path .

citation.text: "Hurkyl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feldon finds a runed cane buried in the glacier's ice.
timeline.quote: The Ronom Glacier was the site where Feldon found a mysterious runed cane

citation.text: "Ronom Glacier", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Terisia City is sacked by forces under Hajar and burned; Feldon and Loran escape through tunnels.
timeline.quote: Terisia City was sacked by forces under the command of Hajar and burned to cinders.

citation.text: "Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hurkyl, Drafna, Feldon, Chayum-Icha, Kathwar and others meet with the Archimandrite to establish the Third Path as a neutral alliance.
timeline.quote: to establish the Third Path , also known as the "Union".

citation.text: "The Archimandrite", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Drafna", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
